title: Cold Climate Heat Pumps: Everything You Need to Know - Trane®
summary: Trane (manufacturer) interview on cold-climate heat pumps: capacity at low temperatures, ENERGY STAR criteria, dual-fuel backup.

assertions.quote: can provide up to 107% heating capacity down to 5°F and up to 85% down to -20°F.
many systems will start to lose delivered heating capacity as it gets colder outside
they act as an energy-efficient air conditioner in the summer.
on those extremely cold days, the furnace takes over to help ensure maximum comfort and maximum heating efficiency.
Trane’s heat pumps for cold climates are suitable for all areas of the United States.

verdicts.note: Cold-climate units heat most US homes, but in climate zones 7-8 they usually need backup heat.
Cold-climate ASHPs proved beneficial in typical Minnesota homes, one of the coldest US climates, but needed backup heat, and the ductless unit should not be used without backup below -15F.
